protocol.feature: 2048-D mean-pooled final VLM image+instruction prefix; raw per-observation keys, before unit averaging
protocol.target: recorded demonstrated actions, normalized active7, 10 steps; no policy-generated predictions
protocol.different_task: different source task file; conservative different initial-state groups
protocol.same_task: different episode; source initial-state IDs unavailable within task
protocol.ci_scope: descriptive task bootstrap conditional on cached model and fixed reference bank; overlapping bank windows are not independent samples

policy_output_crosscheck.model: public SkillNet n10; 3 cached noise draws
policy_output_crosscheck.cache_subset: pre-existing gripper-big 1500-row/449-episode diagnostic; separate from 89-task primary analysis
